Privacy.collectionBody: Pawtner's sign-in, adoption, and operational data is processed by Firebase Authentication and Supabase. Only after you explicitly consent do we enable Firebase Analytics and Firebase Performance to collect non-sensitive dimensions such as page type, feature interactions, pet species and source, plus page loading, network requests, and Core Web Vitals performance data.
Privacy.excludedBody: Analytics events do not include email, name, account identifiers, search text, pet names, questionnaire answers, medical content, or precise locations entered by users. Query strings are removed from URLs and dynamic resource paths are normalized before sending.
Privacy.purposeBody: This data helps us understand adoption workflows, improve the site, and identify performance problems. Google processes Firebase and Google Analytics data under its terms. Analytics event-level retention is set to 14 months; ads personalization and Google Signals remain disabled. Exported aggregate data is available only to authorized Pawtner operators.
Privacy.choiceBody: Analytics and performance collection are off by default. You may grant or withdraw consent at any time. Withdrawal stops future collection without affecting sign-in, security, or other necessary functions. Your preference is stored only in this browser.
Privacy.contactBody: To request access, deletion, or an explanation of data processing, email {email}.
Privacy.contactPrompt: To request access, deletion, or an explanation of data processing, email
Privacy.choiceDescription: Only after you consent will Firebase Analytics and Performance collect anonymized usage and performance data. Necessary sign-in and security functions are unaffected.

Pilot.title: Pilot launch checklist
Pilot.description: Verify the most important trust, data, and operational paths in a consistent order.
Pilot.item1: Verify invitations, sign-in, and role permissions
Pilot.item2: Create a pet draft and complete required information
Pilot.item3: Submit the record and complete partner-team review
Pilot.item4: Confirm public pages exclude private addresses and internal notes
Pilot.item5: Walk through favorites, applications, and status changes
Pilot.item6: Verify donations, supplies, and feature flags
Pilot.item7: Record issues, reports, and follow-up fixes
